design: Sequential practical carrier screen. V1 generated the control only; V2 freezes feasible, explicit candidate gates before either candidate is called.

metric_definitions.strict_valid_generation_count: A nonempty reply accepted by the exact current RightBrain._prepare_model_surface_candidate gate without final rejection reasons.
metric_definitions.raw_language_or_script_pollution_count: Count of raw generations whose raw rejection reasons include cjk_language_leak, nonstandard_cjk_surface, foreign_script_leak, unexpected_ascii_leak, or ascii_symbol_artifact. This is measured before deterministic localization and sanitization.
metric_definitions.final_required_semantics_missing_count: Count of generations whose final production-equivalent gate reasons contain semantic_slots_missing.
metric_definitions.final_polite_register_drift_count: Count of generations whose final production-equivalent gate reasons contain polite_tone_drift or formal_register_drift.
metric_definitions.warm_wall_latency_median_seconds: Median wall latency excluding the first request for that model.

candidate_preference_if_both_pass: Prefer 4B only if it is within one strict-valid output of 9B, is no worse on raw language pollution and final required-semantics failures, and has lower warm median latency. Otherwise select the stronger passing condition by strict validity, raw pollution, semantic failures, then latency.
evidence_boundary: The control result was known when V2 was frozen, but neither candidate had been called. V2 remains a development screen and can authorize only a separately preregistered source-independent holdout for one carrier.
